evidence: Reference values of the September 9 protection design, taken from its stored model outputs. They are component budgets, not a chosen or optimized design; the thrust-held screen fails requirement S6.
reading_rule: count x unit_mass_kg is a module family's held mass. Divide by a lifetime scenario for gross replacement; consumables are continuous flows. The magnet mass is the ideal conductor and support floor; the report plans for 3e14-3e15 kg in all.

modules.description: A 10 x 10 km cell of the titania-silica film with its anti-reflection layers, framing and metrology
modules.failure: Local: a missing cell opens about 1e-6 of the aperture; overlaps and replacement overlays cover it

modules.description: One cell's share of the power, processing, thruster and thermal hardware that holds the screen
modules.failure: Local loss of thrust; an unpowered screen falls toward the Moon within days, so packs need redundancy
